lines.en: label makiinvite1:
I tap on Maki’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
I’m not exactly sure how Ami will handle me inviting over the mother of her arch nemesis, but I’ll be damned if I let an obnoxious girl with A-cups rule my life.
I am an adult looking for another adult to do adult things with- and Maki is the only adult I know who is very rarely busy with anything since her daughter can just take over.
I mean, I guess Sara would also work, but I feel like it’s a lot easier to sell porn than it is to revitalize a failing bar. No offense, Sana.
: Gangbang hotline, this is Maki speaking.
: Before I place an order, are you able to clarify if I would be the one getting gangbanged? Or am I calling to participate in a gangbang?
: I would not be willing to clarify that, no. Would you still like to place an order?
: Sure. One Maki, please.
: Can it be any Maki or are you looking for a particular model?
: Do you want to hang out or are you just going to keep being weird?
: Mmm...I choose both!
: Just don’t be too weird in front of my [niece]. She already kind of hates your daughter, so you’re kind of starting off on thin ice.
: What? Why would anyone ever hate Makoto? Makoto is great.
: I hope your [niece] is ready to throw hands.
: Okay. Sending you the address now.
: How much lube should I-
scene black
I hang up the phone and quickly text Maki my address.
I feel mostly safe in assuming that she won’t actually be bringing any lube, but I ask her to leave everything behind in the event that she just...doesn't care about anything I say.

It’s one thing bringing an older, lazier looking Makoto over to the house, but having her come equipped with what I imagine is an entire collection of lubricant would be too hard for even me to get out of.
Either way, I wait for Maki to confirm that she’s on her way over and slide my phone back into my pocket before setting course home.
scene makifirstinv1
I make my way inside and prepare myself for what I hope will be a rather easy and dramaless night in.
: Get out of here!
It appears that will not be the case.
: I don’t know what I did, but-
: You mean to tell me that for only 1,000 yen a month, I can get all of the lotion I want?!
: That’s right, Ami! And this isn’t just any lotion...it’s lotion guaranteed to keep you looking [young]and energetic for the rest of eternity.
: Ahh, that’s even better! My [uncle]’s not home right now so he won’t get mad at me for saying this, but he really seems to like [younger_girls].
: Does he now? Well, then I...totally understand why you’d want him to look at you that way!
scene black
Maybe I should just come back later.
: Wait, Sensei?! Is that you or did somebody break in?!
scene makifirstinv2
: Hah...Hi, Ami. And hi-
: Felicity Fellatio, at your service!
: Sensei! Miss Fellatio says that for only 1,000 yen a month, I can have all the lotion I want!
: Can I borrow 1,000 yen a month so I can be pretty forever?
: You have a job now. Use your own money.
: Also, don’t you think her last name is kind of suspicious?
: Hm? Isn’t fellatio some type of...Italian dessert or something? Stop being so culturally insensitive, Sensei.
scene makifirstinv3
: Now, I know what you’re thinking.
: Do you really, though?
: Of course! You’re thinking...“Wow! Only 1,000 yen a month?! What a steal!”
: Well, let me tell you this, buddy. It really all starts to make sense when you take a look at our business model.
: You don’t even have any products with you.
: She showed up with a whole suitcase of all different kinds of exotic lotions.

: I thought it was a little strange when she knocked since we don’t really get a lot of door to door salespeople around here, but as soon as I smelled what was inside, I immediately knew what was going on.
: I’m sure you did, Ami.
scene makifirstinv4
: Oh my. It appears we may have a bit of a skeptic on our hands!
: Tell me, fine sir who I have never met before, how would you like to sample some of my one of a kind, exotic hand lotions?
: You mean the “hand lotions” I specifically asked you not to bring?
scene makifirstinv5
: Wait, you were expecting her, Sensei? Did you set up an appointment thingy with this lady?
: My birthday isn’t for a long time, so-
scene makifirstinv6
: Wait, is this an early Christmas present?! You’re getting me a lifetime supply of youthful lotion so I can stay adorable forever?!
: No. This is actually Makoto’s mom and her suitcase is full of a bunch of stuff that is most definitely not lotion.
: ...What?
: Why didn’t you just go along with it?
: Better question, how did you manage to get here before me?
scene makifirstinv7
: I just happened to be making my rounds in the area as a totally legitimate lotion sales rep! And since you scheduled an appointment with me, I was always going to show up.
: Sensei, would you mind explaining to me what is going on here?
: I kind of did already.
: So this actually is Makoto’s mom?
scene makifirstinv8
: Uhh...yes! But just because I lied about my name doesn’t mean I lied about the product!
: I thought you looked familiar...
: Maki, why are you still so focused on selling a product that doesn’t even exist?
scene makifirstinv9
: It’s in my blood, obviously! My job is to sell things! And sometimes, in order to sell things, you need to lie about them!
: “Excuse me, miss, but does this vibrator have multiple speeds?” “Why, of course it does! Just don’t read the part of the box that says it only has one!”
: “Excuse me, miss, but my wrists are very sensitive. Do you have any velcro handcuffs?” “Why, of course I do! Because that product totally exists!”
: How are you still in business?
: Because I sell fucking porn, not security devices. No one’s going to ask for their money back so long as they still have an orgasm at the end of the day.
: You sell what?
scene makifirstinv10
: Corn! Canned! Cobbed! Creamed! Any type of-
scene makifirstinv11
: Pfft~
: Creamed...
scene black
Perhaps I should have played along.
And you know, maybe in another life, I would have.
But as Ami’s legal guardian and a man who, on several occasions, has let her borrow my credit card, I refuse to allow her to get sucked into a fictional pyramid scheme.
Even if it means sentencing her to a life of hating Makoto’s mother- something I’m already sure was going to happen anyway.
scene makifirstinv12
: You betrayed me! I invite you into my house because your suitcase smells good and this is how you repay me?!
: Get out and never come back!
: Fine! I admit it! I took advantage of your trust and made you believe my suitcase full of lubricant was a suitcase full of lotion!
: Why are you selling something that weird door to door?! Are you some kind of...nymphomaniac or something?!
: Ami, come on. You can’t just elect to believe the door to door part of her story. It’s clearly all part of a coordinated effort to-
scene makifirstinv13
: How many more Miyamuras are you going to invite into this household, Sensei?
: If you wind up inviting a third, can you ask him to at least come say hello to his daughter? She misses him.
: I’m not inviting any other Miyamuras over to the house. One was more than enough and that still didn’t deter me from bringing in Maki and her lube collection.
: Heh. You said lube.
scene makifirstinv14
: Get out of my house, you harlot!
: Harlot? Is this the renaissance? Have some dignity and call me a whore like a normal girl.
: I can’t tell which of you is worse! You or Makoto!
: Me, obviously. Makoto is just the prettier, smarter, less sexually confident version. And if there is anything worth admiring in today’s political climate, it is a lack of sexual confidence.
: And also a surplus of sexual confidence. As long as it’s one or the other, things’ll be good.
: Anyway, were you going to buy any lotion or should I start packing my things?
: You’re not planning on leaving already, are you?
scene makifirstinv15
: Why do you want her here when you have me?!
: You’re actually okay with me staying?
: I could have sworn the whole pretending to be a saleswoman and roping your [niece] into a make believe pyramid scheme by calling lube lotion would have been your sign to be like, “Bye, Maki.”
: Well, you have sworn incorrectly.
: Besides, this gives me the opportunity to try something I’ve been wanting to try for a long time now.
: I hope it involves lube, because I brought plenty.
: You can’t be serious!
: I am serious. In fact...I am so serious, that I am, going to do this.
: Lay one finger on her and she’ll be leaving this house in a variety of different bags!
: Ami-
: Go to your room.
scene makifirstinv16
: You didn’t...
: Hah. Get parented, loser.
: Right now, [young]lady.
I do my best to put on an adult voice, but I’m pretty sure it’s just my normal voice.
Probably because I’m an adult.
: You...
: Why do I...actually feel compelled to go to my room?...
: Because starting right now, you are grounded.
scene makifirstinv17
: For...for how long?!
: Until Maki leaves. After that, you can do whatever.
: Why am I in trouble when all I wanted to do was protect your honor?!
: Be careful or he might actually ground you.
: Ami. Room.
scene makifirstinv18
: GRAAAAAAH! I STILL HATE YOU AND YOUR STUPID DAUGHTER!
scene makifirstinv19
Ami [[miraculously] goes into her room and slams the door behind her.
And, in other news, I gained a new power today.
: You know, if I knew this was going to turn into a whole thing, I would have just left the lube behind.
scene makifirstinv20
: You mean like I asked you to?
: I thought that was a joke. I wasn’t about to miss out on an opportunity to break out the travel lube. Do you have any idea how long it’s been since I got to show that to anyone?
: Cause it’s been a long time, Sensei. A long time.
: That aside, I think it’s safe to assume Ami hates you now.
scene makifirstinv21
: Excellent.
: Why is that excellent? Normally, when you get invited over to a person’s house, you’re supposed to try to not make them hate you.
: Normally, yes. But I came here with the knowledge that, for some reason, your fake daughter has a problem with my real daughter.
: She is my [niece], not my daughter.
: I bet she calls you Daddy in her fantasies.
if amimaster.lower() in ["daddy"]:
I mean...she calls me that in a lot more than just her fantasies.
But even if that’s the case, I can’t let Maki actually believe it.
: Her real dad is actually dead, so...probably not.
scene makifirstinv22
: Oh...crap.
: I’m sorry. I didn’t mean to bring up bad memories.
: It’s fine. I don’t have many memories of it in the first place.
scene amiani4
scene makifirstinv22
: Either way, I crossed a line and I’m sorry.
scene makifirstinv23
: But, uhh...what I meant by the whole “excellent” comment is that now, by comparison, Ami will probably hate me a little more than Makoto.
: That wasn’t your plan from the start, was it?
scene makifirstinv24
: No. I just wanted to hang out and talk and maybe show off all of my cool lubes.
: But halfway through my sales pitch, I started thinking, “You know what? This is probably going to go south eventually.”
: In my defense, though, if you hadn’t taken your sweet ass time getting over here, this never would have happened.
: What are you talking about? I came right over after I called you.
: Well then I guess I’m just super fast and you’re the human equivalent of a turtle.
: Anyway, want to go get dinner or something? It’s nice being invited over, but it feels a little strange when your [niece] likely has her ear to the door to make sure we’re not having sex.
: THAT’S RIGHT! RUN AWAY, MAKOTO’S MOM! THIS HOUSE BELONGS TO THE ARAKAWAS!
: See what I mean?
: You’ll grow to accept her in due time. Ami just has a very strong sense of family values.
if amilust15 == True:
In fact, it’s so strong that sometimes she even starts masturbating in my bed while I’m asleep.
Just normal family stuff, I suppose.
scene makifirstinv25
: I wish Makoto was like that.
: Sometimes, I feel like she doesn’t really care what I do.
scene makifirstinv26
: Buuuut I’m not about to start complaining right before we leave.
: I have wreaked enough havoc on your relationship with one [teenager] today, and I’ll be damned if I make you think less of Makoto by complaining or venting to you.
: I mean...if you really want to talk-
: You’ll hear me out and help me with my problems?
: The first part, sure. But if you ever have to come to me for help, you’re likely so far off the deep end that literally no one can help you anymore.
: Blah blah blah self-deprecation and sad stuff. I want meat. Let’s go get...barbecue or something.
: Deal.
scene black
: WAIT! NO! SENSEI! YOU HAVEN’T TOLD ME I CAN LEAVE MY ROOM YET!
: Should you maybe let your [niece] out first? She might have to go to the bathroom at some point.
: She’ll be fine. She’s well behaved when she wants to be.
: NO! DON’T LEAVE ME!
: ESPECIALLY NOT WITH A MIYAMURA!!!!!!!!!!!
Maki and I make our way over to some restaurant close to her shop so that, once we’re done, she can head back home to sub in for Makoto.
As it turns out, Maki was supposed to work tonight and Makoto was supposed to be helping Miku with something.
But, of course, whenever I ask anyone to do anything, they almost always drop their previous plans for me.
Just one of the perks of living in Kumon-mi, I guess.
Anyway, dinner is great and Maki winds up fronting the bill to pay for causing a disturbance at my house.
Was it a disturbance I both expected and created by inviting her there? Yes. But it’s not like I’m going to give away a free dinner in exchange for admitting that.
Instead, I’ll just shelve that idea alongside the thousands of others that I have pushed away from me in a never ending journey toward complacency.
The two of us split apart-
And I go home to let my [niece] out of her cage.
